extracted.name: Coconut Black Bean Soup
extracted.description: Coconut milk, black beans, and tomatoes are simmered with ginger, cumin, and turmeric in this easy soup recipe that will keep you warm on even the coldest day.
ingredient_lines: 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
2 green onions, chopped, or more to taste
2 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine black beans, tomatoes, coconut milk, broth, green onions, ginger, cumin, turmeric, and garlic in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until desired consistency is reached, 30 to 45 minutes. Season with salt.
